data.one_liner: Type-safe Flutter routing with deep linking, web support, and visual route graphs.
data.what_it_does: Defines application screens as types and composes routes as a graph for navigation. Supports imperative stacks, declarative diffing, and a full coordinator model with URI parsing and deep linking.
use_when: You need type-safe navigation and robust deep linking in Flutter apps
You want to organize routes as a graph or manifest with browser URL synchronization
avoid_when: You prefer a very lightweight navigation package without graph-based definitions
You are maintaining a legacy app using standard Navigator 1.0 imperative push/pop without deep links
strengths: Type-safe navigation parameters and deep-link generation
Visual route graph and DevTools support via zenrouter_devtools
Supports multiple navigation paradigms (imperative, declarative, and coordinator)
weaknesses: Requires understanding a custom routing ecosystem compared to basic Navigator
Migration from older versions requires updating capability mixins and manifest bindings
data.setup_notes: Add dependencies to pubspec.yaml and optionally use zenrouter_devtools or zenrouter_file_generator for codegen.
